type: bounded development capacity and retention-identity engineering
question: Can Yggdrasil continue learning beyond its native 1024 episode cap while immutably preserving all old native+six-head weights and old readout, with a bounded additive native segment and six continual specialist heads?
negative_findings: JEPA2-05 source-bound actual training gave development NO-GO and native old Brier interference +0.05167/+0.12553; do not rerun or retune scored seeds 99231/99247.

model_architecture.source_archived: Entire exact 7-component JEPA2-05 model checkpoint preserved byte-for-byte and read only; old model's native/heads not mutated.
model_architecture.additive_native: NativeEpisodeExperience native shards of max 64 events each, max 4 shards, separate from immutable old model; original native episode cap stays unchanged.
model_architecture.specialists: Clone original two action latent heads, two temporal latent heads and two 3-step future heads from original weights. Four original short-horizon heads retain weights with source-count epoch offset to satisfy inherited fixed MAX_EPISODES validation; continue gradient training only on future witnessed source. Two future heads update only once each when a 3-step public future is fully observed; no resets of weights.
model_architecture.update_chronology: At t: score forecasts before witnessing s2/y and future post; observe public outcome once; all six heads update after relevant outcome; source actions for 3-step forecast announced ex ante; no hidden phase/source evaluator label is supplied.
model_architecture.custody: Unique 64-hex source IDs across immutable prior+new native shards; byte-verified parent, no old witness mutations, exact new episode tape replay, cold restore replays all new events to detect forged rehashed source/weights, fail closed on conflict/cap/tamper.
model_architecture.readouts: Expose archived old native readout separately from active native and JEPA heads; do not promote unqualified mixture/selector.

disjoint_dev_source.training_runs: one original source-bound training per OS after frozen prereg and source/test preflight

controls.frozen_original: Old source readout and original six-head parameters byte exact
controls.active_native: new native shard forecasts compared descriptively with prior-fully-fitted Beta
controls.conventional: fully fitted or online Beta on same observed public action/consequence as sidecar; no comparative science claim
controls.zero_training: frozen readouts and output difference to demonstrate actual new training
controls.negative: duplicate/conflict ID, invalid sensor/row, forged rehash, source mutation, future target leak, checkpoint replay, capacity overflow

frozen_engineering_success: Two original 7-component models independently load exact pinned source checkpoint and their old native readout Brier across consumed witnesses unchanged exactly before/after new updates and cold restore
Each receives precisely 32 genuinely new source witnessed interventions; count advances 1022→1054 and 997→1029, both above inherited 1024 capacity without changing legacy native schema/cap
All six specialist head weights source-initialized from original and trained at least once; initial weight provenance exact, step counts monotonic across counter epochs, no reset of parameter weights
30 completed 3-step windows per seed, with outputs only used after public observation; exactly matching new source IDs and events in stored evidence; source-disjoint from consumed JEPA2-05

Independent auditor cold-replays authenticated original+new tape and recomputes prequential metrics without importing original scoring code; same classification and metrics across Linux/Windows tolerance <=1e-8
Independent source-bound full Linux and Windows final regression on exact post-evidence SHA, G29 source-index check and clean trees
development_go_scope: Engineering capacity and integrity only; no pre-registered efficacy gain, no scientific benefit or accepted native value claimed.
stop: Any engineering custody/capacity/control mismatch stops qualification; preserve negative. No post-result scientific retuning or reused source first-use.
